name: Sales CRM Dashboard
short_description: Full-stack CRM for managing sales leads with a dashboard featuring KPIs, funnel analysis, revenue charts, CSV export, and basic auth.
detailed_description: A full-stack sales CRM application built with FastAPI backend and Bootstrap 5 + Plotly.js frontend. Features include lead management, KPI dashboard with funnel analysis, revenue charts, CSV export, and basic authentication.

freelance: Full-stack CRM from design to deployment

highlights: End-to-end full-stack development (FastAPI backend + Bootstrap frontend)
Interactive KPI dashboard with funnel analysis and revenue charts using Plotly.js
CSV export functionality for data analysis
